status: READY, NOT RUN. Waiting on Matt's approval of the five concept sheets (2026-10-26). Do not train before he approves.
fill_in: For each creature: put the approved concept sheet paths in concept_sheets, run --cut, look at tools/art/w5/train/<name>/blobs/*-preview.jpg and fill poses ({sheet file name: {piece index: pose words}}); pieces left out are not used. Then --build and --launch.
pattern: Same as the *-qwen-lora character models (queen_qwen_v1: 23 poses on flat grey, 1500 steps; meeca_qwen_v1: 2500 steps): Qwen-Image, LoRA rank 32, lr 1e-4, adamw8bit, qfloat8, buckets 768/1024, captions '<trigger>, <description>, <pose>, painted storybook illustration, plain grey background'. One ai-toolkit job per creature on rtx-pro-6000 (about 1.2 h each at 1500 steps, about $3.30; all five about $16.50).

style_notes.household: polite and creepy, tea-party style: tidy, mannered, a little too still; big readable eyes
style_notes.wild: painted nature, like the World 1-4 animals; big readable eyes
